paragraphs: R' Chananiah son of R' Hillel. See the entry R' Chanina son of R' Hillel.[^1]

notes.text: The heading has חנניה, Chananiah, and the target חנינא, Chanina. Both explicitly give Hillel as father. All four abbreviated personal titles remain R'.
